{{Quote|To present your passport now, hairless one.|Odeon Farnish|<ref name="RPG" />}}
'''Odeon Farnish''' was a [[Lexlar]] customs official. Farnish wanted a promotion, so thorough searches were conducted in hopes of catching minor infractions, but serious [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] willing to offer bribes were allowed to pass. The inspector was zealous and greedy, with a working knowledge of [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucratic]] procedure.<ref name="RPG" />
